title: Bellman Optimality of Average-Reward Robust Markov Decision Processes with a Constant Gain
abstract: arXiv:2509.14203v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Learning and optimal control under robust Markov decision processes (MDPs) have received increasing attention, yet most existing theory, algorithms, and applications focus on finite-horizon or discounted models. Long-run average-reward formulations, while natural in many operations research and management contexts, remain underexplored. This is primarily because the dynamic programming foundations are technically challenging and only partially understood, with several fundamental questions remaining open. This paper steps toward a general framework for average-reward robust MDPs by analyzing the constant-gain setting. We study the average-reward robust control problem with possible information asymmetries between the controller and an S-rectangular adversary. Our analysis centers on the constant-gain robust Bellman equation, examining both the existence of solutions and their relationship to the optimal average reward. Specific

translated_title: 具有常数增益的平均奖励鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程的贝尔曼最优性
translated_abstract: 鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程（MDP）下的学习与最优控制受到了越来越多的关注，然而现有的大多数理论、算法和应用都集中在有限时域或折扣模型上。长期平均奖励模型虽然在许多运筹学和管理学情境中非常自然，但相关研究仍然不足。这主要是因为其动态规划基础在技术上具有挑战性且仅被部分理解，若干基本问题仍悬而未决。本文通过分析常数增益设定，朝着建立平均奖励鲁棒MDP的一般框架迈出了一步。我们研究了在控制器与S-矩形对手之间可能存在信息不对称的平均奖励鲁棒控制问题。我们的分析以常数增益鲁棒贝尔曼方程为中心，考察了解的存在性及其与最优平均奖励之间的关系。
tldr: 本文通过研究常数增益设定下S-矩形不确定性对应的鲁棒贝尔曼方程解的存在性及其与最优平均奖励的关系，为平均奖励鲁棒马尔可夫决策过程建立了理论框架。
en_tdlr: This paper advances a general framework for average-reward robust MDPs by analyzing the constant-gain robust Bellman equation, establishing the existence of solutions and their connection to the optimal average reward under S-rectangular ambiguity with possible information asymmetries.
